item.title: Using CloudReady to Make a Chrome OS Installation Boot Disk
item.description: 1. Download the Image File Click here, and from the CloudReady website download the DOWNLOAD 64-BIT or DOWNLOAD 32-BIT image. After extracting it, you get a cloudready-free-xxx-bit.bin file. 2. Install the Chromebook Recovery Utility First install the Chrome browser, then open this page and install the Chromebook Recovery Utility. 3. Create the Image Step one, open the Chromebook Recovery Utility.
